entries.a394e399ec420668: This business researches, develops, manufactures and sells prescription drugs dispensed at hospitals and over-the-counter drugs sold at pharmacies, and most of Eisai Co., Ltd.'s revenue comes from it. The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] divides the Pharmaceutical Business by region into five (Japan, Americas (North America), China, EMEA (Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Russia and Oceania), and East Asia & Global South (South Korea, Taiwan, India, ASEAN, Central and South America, South Africa, etc.)) and designates these five as [[term:segment|reportable segments]]. Total revenue of the five regions for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥810,779 million, accounting for most of the company's total revenue of ¥825,378 million. The company is focusing its efforts on neurology (centered on dementia) and oncology (centered on refractory cancers). Company-wide revenue by product was ¥362,668 million for oncology products, ¥260,568 million for neurology products and ¥202,142 million for other products. There are three key drugs. The anticancer drug Lenvima (revenue ¥342.5 billion) is a co-developed and co-promoted drug with US Merck, with which the company signed an agreement on March 7, 2018; the Alzheimer's disease treatment Leqembi (¥88.0 billion, up 98.7% year on year) is a co-developed and co-promoted drug with Biogen Inc. (US), with which it signed an agreement on March 4, 2014. The third is the insomnia treatment Dayvigo (¥64.3 billion, up 19.6% year on year). In addition, the segment profit of the five regions combined (¥367,323 million) does not include research and development expenses of ¥138,353 million that are not allocated to each region, or head office management costs and other items of the parent company totaling ¥189,340 million. The latter includes ¥158,204 million of profit sharing for Lenvima payable to US Merck; after deducting these items, the company's total operating profit was ¥44,138 million. The number of employees was 9,832 as of March 31, 2026.
